review_notes: I read the whole file and compared it with GuitartExact/Basic.lean and a grep of `opEquivalence` declarations across Mathlib/CategoryTheory. The file defines the equivalence `structuredArrowRightwardsOpEquivalence`, with its auxiliary `functor` and `inverse`. These relate `(w.op.StructuredArrowRightwards g)ᵒᵖ` to `w.CostructuredArrowDownwards g.unop`. I found no existing Mathlib equivalence between these two specific categories, and the other `opEquivalence` declarations concern different categories (Square, Triangle). The instances `guitartExact_id'` and `guitartExact_of_isEquivalence_of_isIso'` are the dual orientations of `guitartExact_id` and `guitartExact_of_isEquivalence_of_isIso` in Basic.lean. `guitartExact_id'` takes the square (F, 𝟭, 𝟭, F), while `guitartExact_id` takes (𝟭, F, F, 𝟭). The `'` variant requires T and B to be equivalences, while the unprimed one requires L and R. They have different hypotheses and conclusions, so they are not competing versions of one concept. `guitartExact_id'` is also used elsewhere, in Localization/DerivabilityStructure/Basic.lean. I found no justified duplicate-concept finding. I checked only the Mathlib sources and did not search for further hidden uses.
